guard_purpose: Preserve the scientific identity of the 2020 release and prevent current 2024 documentation, assets or methods from being silently assigned to it.

release_2020.scientific_object: land-use and land-cover classification associated with the TerraClass Amazônia 2020 mapping context
release_2020.known_scope_statement: TerraClass qualifies land use and land cover in areas related to PRODES-detected deforestation; exact release coverage must be verified from release-specific documentation and assets.

newer_2024_context.scope: bioma Amazônia and bioma Cerrado products available through the GeoPortal TerraClass
newer_2024_context.input_and_processing_statement: The 2024 mapping uses Sentinel-2/MSI imagery, a 16-day product with 10 m spatial resolution, and Brazil Data Cube/SITS processing.
newer_2024_context.series_statement: The public communication describes an Amazônia series from 2008 to 2024 and a Cerrado series from 2018 to 2024.

mandatory_controls: Do not copy the 2024 Sentinel-2, 16-day or 10 m processing statements into PR000005 without 2020-specific evidence.
Do not replace PR000005 with the 2024 release; model the newer release separately when curated.
Do not infer the 2020 CRS, grid, output pixel size, legend codes, checksum, license or citation from current portal metadata.
Keep source imagery resolution distinct from nominal output pixel size.
Keep Amazônia Legal, bioma Amazônia, PRODES-cleared areas and complete-biome mapping statements distinct unless the 2020 release documentation resolves them.
Require direct inspection of a 2020-specific asset or metadata record before final curatorial approval.

evidence.restriction: historical project page does not establish the technical profile of the 2020 release

supports: continuing work on other classes at publication time
evidence.restriction: partial secondary-vegetation result is not the complete 2020 land-use legend or asset contract
must not be back-projected onto the 2020 release
general catalog metadata does not establish release-specific CRS, grid, checksum or legend

release_creation_rule: A new normalized TerraClass 2024 product release requires its own stable ID, evidence set, distributions, asset profile and review; it must not mutate PR000005.
required_before_2020_approval: Locate a release-specific 2020 metadata record or authoritative documentation.
Inspect the actual 2020 raster or vector asset.
Record CRS, grid, geometry or raster structure and nominal output resolution from the asset.
Record the complete legend and codes from the release-specific source.
Record distribution URL, media type, byte size and SHA-256 when technically feasible.
Resolve release-specific license and recommended citation.
Reconcile the inspected asset with the existing accuracy profile before approving the review.
